title: Crater Chisel
body:
Crater Chisel

The Crater Chisel is an item added from the 2025 Halloween event. It can be obtained at The Monstrous Manor.

How to obtain

The Crater Chisel can be obtained by crafting with Hardened moon rod and First Quarter Moon Shard in Altar at the top of The Manor:

  1. Go to 3rd floor of manor with Hardened moon rod and First Quarter Moon Shard.
  2. Turn left and go to the window near the Ghost NPC.
  3. There are some levitating stones outside the window-simple parkour that you need to pass with components to craft the chisel.
  4. Place Hardened moon rod and first quarter moon shard to altar and wait till the reaction.
